title: Ethel Waters owned the Chicago club but her boyfriend ran it
summary: Waters rarely appeared and Turner would not name her boyfriend.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: Oh. And you talked about working in Ethel Waters' club in Chicago. Was she actually there running it, or did she just own it?
She just owned the club. She never was there half the time. Her boyfriend run the joint.
I don't remember the fellow's name.
